name: Phoxene Plumule
desc:
A crystal harvested from a Heaventree — one of the most widely used minerals across Atlasia.
It emits a gentle glow, reminiscent of a full moon's radiance.
desc2:
"Heaventrees, their branches aglow with crystalline fruit, once bathed the southern towers in silver light. From that radiance, humanity's earliest faiths took root. A millennium later, scholars in pursuit of the trees' secrets distilled from them a substance known as Phoxichor — the very essence of their light. Thus began Atlasia's age of Blue Gold and whirring gears. Once more, mankind stood at the cusp of transformation... The history of Atlasia is — and has always been — the history of Heaventrees."

— Tachitus, Elysian Historian, Chronicles

name: Phoxene
desc:
High-grade Phoxene derived from Phoxene Plumule.
Like precious metals, they function as common currency across Atlasia, accepted universally for trade.
desc2:
"I'd say Phoxene is less currency, more 'bewitching stones' with an allure that no one can resist. In Atlasia, many have ventured through great trials and hardships, or even perished, all in the quest for these tiny rocks."

— Comnena, Chief Librarian of the Aethyrie Cloud Cavern Library, in "Betwixt Leaves and Branches—History of Atlasia"

name: Coin
desc:
A standard coin used across all of the Atlasia Continent.
Low in value but essential for daily transactions.
desc2:
"One, two, three... three hundred and sixty! Behold, the Demon King's piggy bank of dreams. I now grant this to you — make sure it's put to good use!"

— Snow the "Demon King"

name: Carmine Globule
desc:
Condensed liquid globules designed to empower Demon Wedges. If Daimons are the demons roaming the mortal realm, then this material surely serves as a feast of power dedicated to them.
Developed by the Hyperborean Spathatoi Alchademy, these globules were inspired by ancient tablets unearthed by the Archaeological Association — the cryptic inscriptions on these tablets are believed to conceal mysterious powers.
desc2:
"Spirits of kindred align, resonating as one. 
In crimson deep, awaken powers asleep."

— Inscription from an unearthed tablet in the Askard Fjord

name: Sanergy
desc: Taking on Commissions consumes Sanergy.
desc2:
"While focused dedication is admirable, it's all about balance and moderation. Overexertion leading to frailty and weariness is a folly to be avoided."

— Fushu, Huaxu Apothecary

name: Luno Coin – CBT2
desc: A rare currency that can be exchanged for various rewards. Only usable during the Second Closed Beta Test.
desc2: A priceless gift for participants of the Second Closed Beta Test.

name: Lucent Prism
desc: The kaleidoscope, casting a prismatic profusion of light — a sliver, caught by eyes in the darkness, unfolds countless worlds in motion.
desc2:
"This is the 'Rainbow.' It's right there in your palm, hidden inside this small, glittering tube. Turn it, and you can see forests, constellations, snow stretching like an endless desert... Berry, {nickname}, even if we have to stay hidden in these ruins for now, I still want you both to see a world far more vast and wondrous."

— ???

name: Iridescent Prism
desc: The kaleidoscope, casting a prismatic profusion of light — a sliver, caught by eyes in the darkness, unfolds countless worlds in motion.
desc2:
"This is the 'Rainbow.' It's right there in your palm, hidden inside this small, glittering tube. Turn it, and you can see forests, constellations, snow stretching like an endless desert... Berry, {nickname}, even if we have to stay hidden in these ruins for now, I still want you both to see a world far more vast and wondrous."

— ???

name: Lunotress's Monthly Pass #1
desc: A recurring Phoxene delivery arranged through Lunotress. Grants a daily supply for the duration of the subscription.
desc2:
"Mmm... Order confirmed. Be sure to drop by for your daily Phoxene... Yaaawn... Now, back to my nap... Zzzzz..."

 — Lunotress

name: Bard's Tome: Hardcover Edition
desc: A neatly bound Hardcover Edition compiling once-scattered verses.

name: Bard's Tome: Collector's Edition
desc: A finely bound Collector's Edition compiling once-scattered verses.

name: Badge of Compilation
desc: Redeemable for one Geniemon of your choice from the Lore Compilation reward pool. A testament to your journey, and a token of gratitude.

name: Badge of Compilation
desc: Redeemable for one Geniemon of your choice from the Lore Compilation reward pool. A testament to your journey, and a token of gratitude.

name: Track-Shift Module
desc: Produced from the Hyperborean Empire, a precision instrument very similar to a toolbox. When its gears start to move, the Demon Wedge placed inside will be modified to better suit the user's state. Because it acts directly on the user, this style has higher precision, and after use, it can further enhance the user's abilities.
desc2:
"Mastering the art of using tools on the right occasions isn't laziness. In fact, it's a vital tactic for wrapping up battles efficiently. As for the time saved, it's naturally meant for relaxing one's weary body and mind with a well-deserved sleep..."

— Randy, Hyperborean Officer

name: Weapon Track-Shift Module
desc: Produced from the Hyperborean Empire, a precision instrument very similar to a toolbox. When its gears start to move, the Demon Wedge placed inside will be modified to better suit the user's state. This style has good detection capabilities for various types of weapons, and its use can further increase the weapon's abilities.
desc2:
"Of course, weapons have their own temperaments! If she's upset, it throws me off in combat... It's only natural to feel this way, as we are the closest comrades and partners! Am I right, Samael?"

— Lisbell, candidate for "Patience" of the Seven Virtues of Elysium

name: Embers
desc: Everything is destined to burn, to be devoured and reduced to ashes, ultimately sinking into the abyss.
desc2:
"I beg of you... please don't take my final gleam of light..."

—A twisted figure in the abyss

name: Sanergy Tonic
desc: A tonic developed by the Alchemy Academy to enhance stamina. Commonly issued as part of standard military supplies.
desc2:
"Like tea and coffee, it's just another way to squeeze out more energy and keep going. But honestly, the only real cure for exhaustion is proper rest, so if you're tired, go get some sleep... zZZ..."

— Lunotress

name: Glazeystal
desc: A shard of a sacred relic recovered from the Abyss across countless cycles of revival. It appears to bear a blessing beyond mortal ken.
desc2:
"I can no longer move, so please, take my lantern. Carry me, carry us all, and spread the divine light... into every corner of the abyss..."

—Last words of a Pioneer Knight

name: Commission Manual: Volume Ⅰ
desc:
Increases commission rewards by 100%.
As your team, The Noctoyagers, rise to prominence among the Phoxhunters, more and more commissions come your way. While this entails heavier responsibilities, it also leads to greater rewards.
desc2:
"Let's see, today's commissions include... finding a lost wallet, saving a stray cat on the roof, and mending a broken heart?? Handling all these trivial jobs one by one is a real hassle. I'll just bundle them together and finish them in one go."

— Outsider, a Phoxhunter

desc:

— Outsider, a Phoxhunter

name: Angler's Token
desc: A coin stamped with the emblem of a fish — treasured by anglers far and wide. The more you collect, the higher you climb in the fishing ranks. Trade them in for better gear and prove yourself the slickest fish hunter out there.
desc2:
Take it. Consider it your graduation gift. Don't underestimate this little coin — I've spent a lifetime chasing fish that couldn't stand the sight of me. This coin... is all I have left to give.

— A veteran angler clutching a coin, reluctant to let go

name: Secret Letter Clue
desc: For Phoxhunters, gathering whispers and weaving clues are part of the craft. With persistent cultivation and accumulation, a steady stream of commissions will soon follow.
desc2:
"Gold buried deep must be drawn with bare hands.
Jewels under the currents only gleam for keen eyes.
So too the Phoxhunters' treasure —
They lie hidden between the words, in full measure."

— Percy Ballard, wandering bard, Song of the Phoxhunters

name: Ticket Stub
desc: Etched with stage-light and heartbeat, it keeps the show's afterglow. Redeemable for various items.

name: Thread of Time
desc: Spun from a tangle of paths, this thread bears silent witness to your every step. All that is uncertain, all that faltered, all left unresolved... shall one day find its answer along Her silken weave.
desc2:
"On the night of the full moon, its light spills across every corner of the tower. And the Goddess of Fate, in all Her grace, gathers that silver radiance — spinning it into the finest thread, weaving it into a veil of glistening white. So fine no mortal eye can trace it... and yet vast enough to enfold the fates of the world."
 
 — Tales of the Tower, an Elysian children's book

name: Phoxhunter's Canto
desc: Challenging commissions and extraordinary adventures have shaped the Phoxhunters' legend — a tale carried through every street and alley.
desc2:
"Fill up your goblets; let the wine flow down!
 Tonight belongs to the Phoxhunters, and theirs alone.
 Be stingy not with flowers or coin —
 A hero, a walking legend, deserves their shining crown!"
 
 — Percy Ballard, wandering bard, Song of the Phoxhunters

name: Team Pass
desc: Only Phoxhunter teams that have proven themselves through many commissions earn the right to this pass and the chance to compete for higher ranks. The system protects newcomers while recognising the skill of veteran Phoxhunters.
desc2: Only Phoxhunter teams that have proven themselves through many commissions earn the right to this pass and the chance to compete for higher ranks. The system protects newcomers while recognising the skill of veteran Phoxhunters.

name: Phoxcoin
desc: Proof of participating in the Apex Rankings — a mark of honour among Phoxhunters.
desc2: Proof of participating in the Apex Rankings — a mark of honour among Phoxhunters.

name: Phoxcoin
desc: Proof of participating in the Apex Rankings — a mark of honour among Phoxhunters.
desc2: Proof of participating in the Apex Rankings — a mark of honour among Phoxhunters.

name: Starglow Coin
desc:
A commemorative coin that gleams like starlight. Exchange it for various rewards.
 Dress to impress and shine like a star.

name: Repertoire Keepsake
desc: A commemorative keepsake from the theatre, inscribed with the legends and emotions of every stage. Can be exchanged for special rewards.

name: Reputation Perk: Icelake
desc: This item lets you ride mounts and fly within Icelake.
desc2: Once you've amassed enough reputation, society will turn a blind eye — even to the most unreasonable behaviour.

name: Reputation Perk: Mistwharf
desc: This item lets you ride mounts and fly within Mistwharf.
desc2: Once you've amassed enough reputation, society will turn a blind eye — even to the most unreasonable behaviour.

name: Pristine Hourglass
desc: An hourglass captures not just sand, but the passage of time and cherished memories. It bears witness to a multitude of splendors and countless stories.
desc2:
"O The Spindle of fate!
That which thou weaveth 
Is grains of sand, a cord entwined in silicate— 
Alone it knows neither beginning nor end!"

—Excerpt from The Spindle of the Goddess of Fate, by an anonymous poet

name: Toy Hammer
desc:
It's a bit of a mystery why a luno at the age of Snow's Granny has taken a fancy to toy hammers. Perhaps it's a smith's quirk?
Offering up toy hammers can bump you up the forging schedule. She swears it's just proper respect for the elderly, not bribery!
desc2:
"What's this for, you say? Come here — Hoy! Get it? It's to spare me the bother of those annoying questions without drawing blood!"

— Lunosmith

name: Prismatic Hourglass
desc: An hourglass captures not just sand, but the passage of time and cherished memories. It bears witness to a multitude of splendors and countless stories.

Alone it knows neither beginning nor end!"

desc: An hourglass captures not just sand, but the passage of time and cherished memories. It bears witness to a multitude of splendors and countless stories.

That which thou weaveth

Alone it knows neither beginning nor end!"

—Excerpt from The Spindle of the Goddess of Fate, by an anonymous poet

name: Recasting Mould
desc: Even a humble blade, struck a thousand times upon the anvil, may cast off its fetters and be reborn keen.
desc2:
Don't fret, little one — it's only been melted down. With this mould at hand, this old smith'll have you a finer blade in no time. 
 — Lunosmith

name: Reforge Salvager Ⅰ
desc: Used to reforge Demon Wedges

name: Reforge Salvager Ⅱ
desc: Used to reforge Demon Wedges

name: Starweave Thread
desc: A radiant thread shimmering with starlight. Use it to obtain skins in specific events.
desc2:
"Like painting and sculpture, the art of weaving carries the light of beauty. To hold this thread is to hold a key to the temple of aesthetics. Will you be the one these works of art have been waiting for?"

— Amiette, an Artist

name: Gliscent Needle
desc: The needle's tip draws trails of light, stitching new raiment from the weave of thread and fate. It can be used to upgrade certain character cosmetics.
desc2:
"With every stitch, the transformation draws closer. I see a new work of art slowly coming to life — born from the tender dance between thread and fingertip."

— Amiette, an Artist

name: Trial EXP
desc: It's the testament to your journey through thick and thin, the echoes of your laughter and tears, and the essence of your hard-earned wisdom — remember? You are neither frail nor alone.
desc2:
"Go to them, find solace amongst the banished souls.
Endure the twilight's cleansing, navigate through the boundless gloom,
Together, towards the dawn of a new day."
— ???

name: Trial EXP
desc: It's the testament to your journey through thick and thin, the echoes of your laughter and tears, and the essence of your hard-earned wisdom — remember? You are neither frail nor alone.

"Go to them, find solace amongst the banished souls.
Endure the twilight's cleansing, navigate through the boundless gloom,

name: Verse
desc:
Verses inspired from the stories of your adventure. Once all have been found, a new ballad shall emerge.
Transcribed and adapted by Lirico, these lines ride the wind and falling leaves, echoing through the skies of Atlasia — sung by bards, shaped by your every step.
desc2: Transcribed and adapted by Lirico, these lines ride the wind and falling leaves, echoing through the skies of Atlasia — sung by bards, shaped by your every step.

name: Progress Score
desc:
Earned by completing daily tasks. Use it to claim your daily reward.
From grand quests to the simplest errands, each mark brings you closer to your goal — proof that no effort goes unnoticed.
desc2: From grand quests to the simplest errands, each mark brings you closer to your goal — proof that no effort goes unnoticed.

name: Returnee Points
desc: Points earned from [Returnee Quests]. Used to claim milestone rewards.
desc2: RESOURCE_TEXT_2005

name: Weapon Manual Ⅰ
desc: A book about the use of weapons, it looks very thick, and this accumulation will turn into your strength.
desc2:
"Fiery sparks lash against your cheeks, while the clang of steel tears through your ears.
Should your heart tremble for it, should your blood surge for it,
Then step forth, and wield your blade,
Embrace the fate of battle, until there is no turning back."

— Anonymous, on the title page of "The Art of Combat"

desc: A book about the use of weapons, it looks very thick, and this accumulation will turn into your strength.

name: Combat Melody Ⅰ
desc: A single sheet of music, recording heroic epics passed among minstrels, filled with many handwritten annotations and modifications. To fully express their views, poets didn't hesitate to use tiny writing to exchange and debate in every blank space on the paper, where numerous perspectives are established and then overturned, making reading the entire piece a thrilling experience.
desc2:
"I'm with Sander on this. In the earliest renditions, Euaron bore no malevolence. She was a singer in the realm of duality. Her voice, like the breeze soothing the warriors' souls, bestowed them with the courage for battle. It's clear that across a dozen later versions, Euaron's enchanting voice remains her hallmark." — Mayya

"The concept of the realm of duality and Euaron's root are utterly disconnected, with no linguistic theories to support such a claim. This is clearly a far-fetched association." — Torina

"What are you arguing about? It's all gibberish to me." — Rees


"Oi! Quit yapping utter tripe that just fills the air!" — Mitty

name: Tavern Gossip
desc: "You're kind of a big deal at The Asphodel these days. Those drunks won't stop spinning tales about you — most of it's made up."
desc2: RESOURCE_TEXT_2015

name: Tales at Sea
desc: "So you're the hotshot the Starweavers have been talking about out on the road."
desc2: RESOURCE_TEXT_2016

name: D10 Die
desc:
Used for re-rolling following a failed Impression Check.
Human interactions are invariably fraught with difficulties. Face them head-on and try again.
desc2:
"Humans, as social creatures, are willing to pay unimaginable prices to alter others' perceptions of them, for better or worse. It might take effort, love, or just a little nudge from some big shot in the 'herd'."

— Camilla, Proprietor of The Asphodel in Icelake

name: Yum Treat
desc:
A treat favoured by Geniemons, can be used to feed them.
True to its name, if these creatures could speak, they would surely exclaim, "Yum!"
desc2:
"The secret recipe that every Geniemon craves: three parts fruit, two slices of choice meat, all topped off with a generous, never-expiring dollop of love." 

— A true Geniemon enthusiast

name: Yum-Yum Treat
desc:
A treat most-favoured by Geniemons, can be used to feed them.
True to its name, if these creatures could speak, they would surely exclaim, "Yum-yum!"
desc2:
"The secret recipe that every Geniemon craves: three parts fruit, two slices of choice meat, all topped off with a generous, never-expiring dollop of love." 

— A true Geniemon enthusiast

name: Yum Cream
desc:
A nourishing treat favoured by Geniemons. Grants 100 EXP when used to upgrade these helpful companions.
True to its name, if Geniemons could talk, they'd definitely exclaim: "Yum!"
desc2:
"Dull coat? Low energy? Probably just a lack of proper nutrients. Here — try this little mix I made. Oh, don't get me wrong! I'm not saying you haven't been taking good care of your Geniemons!"
— A well-meaning Geniemon lover, trying to reassure a worried friend

name: Yum-Yum Cream
desc:
A nourishing treat favoured by Geniemons. Grants 300 EXP when used to upgrade these helpful companions.
True to its name, if Geniemons could talk, they'd definitely exclaim: "Yum-yum!"
desc2:
"Dull coat? Low energy? Probably just a lack of proper nutrients. Here — try this little mix I made. Oh, don't get me wrong! I'm not saying you haven't been taking good care of your Geniemons!"
— A well-meaning Geniemon lover, trying to reassure a worried friend

name: Yum-Yum-Yum Cream
desc:
A nourishing treat favoured by Geniemons. Grants 1000 EXP when used to upgrade these helpful companions.
True to its name, if Geniemons could talk, they'd definitely exclaim: "Yum-yum-yum!"
desc2:
"Dull coat? Low energy? Probably just a lack of proper nutrients. Here — try this little mix I made. Oh, don't get me wrong! I'm not saying you haven't been taking good care of your Geniemons!"
— A well-meaning Geniemon lover, trying to reassure a worried friend

name: Yum-Yum Milk
desc:
A creamy beverage favoured by Geniemons — ideal ascending them.
True to its name, if Geniemons could talk, they'd definitely exclaim: "Yum-yum!"
desc2:
"Mmm... smells so sweet and creamy... You think if I sneak a sip, I'll grow bigger and stronger?"
— A whimsical Geniemon lover, feeding his Geniemon a bottle of Yum-Yum Milk

name: Uh-Oh Treat
desc:
A beloved snack among Geniemons. Feed one this treat, and it'll twist into an Eldritch Geniemon.
So tasty, it's literally transformative.
desc2:
"I never even knew it could do that. I don't know what it's made of, either. Maybe it hit me in a drunken haze... maybe I passed out mid-cuddle. Or maybe — just maybe — it's because I love my Geniemon friends that much."
 — A true Geniemon enthusiast

name: Impression in Icelake: Benefit
desc: Boosts a character's Benefit Impression in Icelake

name: Impression in Icelake: Morality
desc: Boosts a character's Morality Impression in Icelake

desc: Boosts a character's Chaos Impression in Icelake

name: Artificer Rod: Mint
desc:
Huaxu legends tell of a master angler whose true name has long been forgotten. People simply call him Old Angler Jiang. They say he could cast an empty line and still land a fish, every time.
 Everyone knows tricks like that are wishful thinking — but commissioning a Jishu artisan to recreate his rod is easy enough.
desc2:
Rumour has it Old Angler Jiang needed nothing more than a bamboo pole and a thin line — no bait at all — to land whatever fish he fancied, Loongscion or Earthborn alike.
— A Huaxu angler who prefers to stay anonymous

name: Amplification Stimulator
desc: A tool crafted by alchemists to boost the power of Demon Wedges. On the resource-starved front lines, finding a way to unleash a Demon Wedge's full potential with minimal materials once posed a persistent challenge.
desc2:
"Alchemy began as the art of drawing something from nothing. So spare no complaints about the hardship that comes with the job — we are, after all, forging a new world."
 
— Slogan of the Spathatoi Demon Wedge Programme

name: Impression in Huaxu: Benefit
desc: Boosts a character's Benefit Impression in Huaxu

desc: Boosts a character's Morality Impression in Huaxu

name: Withered Bough
desc: A weathered old bough, snapped by fierce winds, bearing the scars of erosion that seem to have sapped it of all life.
desc2:
"'A withered bough feels the gale, the ocean implies the chill.'
Hearken and behold, the path ahead whispers its secrets through every leaf and twig — all creation is a bearer of tidings."

— Yaoguang, Pioneer of the Huaxu Jishu Sect

name: Galeweaver
desc: Originating from the Hyperborean Empire, powered by Phoxichor, this apparatus generates tremendous gusts. On grand occasions, these artificial winds elevate petals, banners, and the very grandeur of the empire.
desc2:
"Humanity's relentless pursuit to grasp power has led to innumerable tragedies and yet, it has carved their place in history. Over the aeons, they've lit bonfires in wildlands, extracted ice from glaciers, sowed fields with crops, and corralled air currents in the winds. Thus, nature's elements gradually became tools at their disposal, easing their existence and embellishing their chronicles."

— Comnena, Chief Librarian of the Aethyrie Cloud Cavern Library, in "Betwixt Leaves and Branches—History of Atlasia"

name: Oceanifly
desc: A butterfly navigating the ocean through air currents. Even in still weather, it can glide across the ocean via the currents generated from flapping its delicate wings — a small marvel with the ability to command the winds.
desc2:
"With delicate flutters, an Oceanifly can reach Luca's shores. The gentle air currents underneath the wings lift nothing heavier, but as they start to roam, what then? They might vanish, or perhaps grow stronger, traversing oceans and lands, evolving into a sweeping sandstorm across the realm of Khemet."

— Miller, Aethyrie scholar

name: Tempest Piercer
desc: Originating from Huaxu, this colossal and weighty arrow defies even the fiercest storms. One can scarcely conceive who might wield such a bolt, yet its meteor-like trail across the heavens shall be indelibly etched in the memory of any witnesses.
desc2:
In Huaxu's nascent years, ill portents befell the heavens. Venus shone by day; stars plummeted into the boundless deep. Across the wilds, Filthoids ran rampant as the Defilement spread.

Yang, traversing the realm his great hunt to make, smote the beast Chisel-Tooth within the Cursed Waters and did capture the Great Swine amidst the Mulberry Groves. Unto his vassals he bestowed arrows, commanding his lords to hunt nineteen great beasts, subduing all beneath heaven. Thus did all yield, proclaiming Yang their sovereign.

— Ban Ye, the Grand Historiographer, in "The Annals of Huaxu"

name: Flame Lizard Scale
desc: Scales from a desert lizard, specially structured to endure scorching heat without harm. This trait adds credence to the fabled kinship between lizards and dragons, though the latter, a creature of beauty, dwells only in the realms of myth and fantasy.
desc2:
"Its radiance is unmistakable, even a hundred meters away. This cloak, meticulously crafted from myriad Flame Lizard scales, stands as an undeniable work of art. Forged in Khemet's golden age, its fiery red hue, shimmering like living flames under the sun, captures the essence of this passionate land.
Years later, Queen Lamia donned it on the battlefield, unwavering amidst ceaseless gunfire and sorcery. The enduring standoff lasted days and nights, with no turning back nor retreat, leaving the fires to burn on to this day."

— "Refraction", designed by Fiama

name: Everbright Flame
desc: The eternal flame of sanctity, a beacon signifying that Khemet endures as long as this fire burns. To the desert folk, offering fire is a gesture of everlasting friendship.
desc2:
"In Khemet, the newborn are bathed in the glow of flames; upon death, they're liberated from corporeal chains by fire. Life may fade with time, but the soul lives on within the fire for eternity."

— Seth, King of Khemet, in "A Proclamation to the People of Khemet"

name: Fire-Tempered Shackles
desc: Shackles of exceptional make, forged over ages and impervious to heat, crafted to bind even the wildest of captives.
desc2:
"I'd warn you not to go any further. Inside are prisoners serving endless sentences, shackled with chains that have no locks nor keys — all caught by the warden herself, those troubled souls. That's right, even she can't melt those iron clamps. Nowhere to run, no mercy to spare, that's our warden."

— A seasoned jailer's warning to a newcomer

name: Solidified Lava
desc: A lava stone gradually losing its heat, sheathed in a crust of cooled black rock; one can get fleet glimpses of its subsiding magma inside.
desc2:
"Wow! It's so incredibly beautiful! Look at that, an active volcano ready to blow any second! Pardon my bland comment, bet someone from the Symposium would've spun some fancier words. Wait, what's up with that dark cloud? Oh no, no, no, NOOOO!"

— An unnamed travel enthusiast

name: Azure Pearl
desc: Luca's distinctive blue pearls, typically irregularly shaped when harvested from azure shells, the spherical, plump varieties being rarer. Visitors to Luca should beware of cheap, dyed imitations.
desc2:
"Practicing art is like pearl diving: high pressure, little reward, always life-risking, and it drives you mad. In my class, I don't want toilet-paper essays or your trashy projects. Get your buns into the sea, find ordinary Pearl B, blue irregular Pearl A, and blue round Pearl S; return empty-handed and you fail! If you die in there, it's a fail too! Think it through before you take my class!"

—— Azura, Professor at Luca National Academy of Arts

name: Humectant
desc: Highly absorbent resin, also known as a water-retaining agent, widely used in sectors like agriculture, forestry, horticulture, and construction. Although the Luca people have long utilized similar techniques for fish preservation, systematic study and mass production only started under the aegis of the Empire.
desc2:
"Perfume is the humectant of love. Whomever you're falling for, it keeps their love for you from withering...
I can see it from your eyes that you're in dire need of one right now, aren't you?"

— Rebecca, Perfumer of Luca

name: Water Purifier
desc: Originating from the Hyperborean Empire, this compact water purifier, standard issue for the imperial expeditionary forces, is employed to purify water on the march, safeguarding soldiers' health.
desc2:
"The greatest invention of the Alchemy Academy; I use it as a cold-brew teapot. Mmm, it does give the tea a unique taste. Being able to enjoy tea of this quality on the battlefield, I am quite content!"

— Randy, Hyperborean Officer

name: Cryo Teargem
desc: Ice harvested from the far north, exceedingly rare and clear as crystal, glinting like dew. Its process of melting and refreezing mirrors the tears on the Creator's lashes.
desc2:
"As summer arrives, I hear the glaciers melting, trickling, and dripping. I don't want to liken this sound to nature weeping — it's merely a fragment of the cycle. Nature is devoid of sentiment; it is I who want to weep, for I can never reach the other side of these mountains for life."

— Diary of a Watchtower Guard of the Askard Tribe

name: Lightning Rod
desc: This apparatus channels thunderstorms beneath the earth. It is an innovation from Huaxu, a realm where the yearning for the heavens surpasses terrestrial confines.
desc2:
"Huaxu's buildings are mostly wooden, so they've mastered fire prevention. I once read some of their designs for mechanism arts: they hoped to add storage devices to lightning rods, aiming to turn 'natural electricity' into a new power source... Wonder if they succeeded."

— Dylan the Walking Encyclopedia, in "Into the Unseen Corners"

name: Stormfall Jade
desc: A special mineral that fell to the ground on a stormy night, with mirror-like facets and subtle purple currents flickering within.
desc2:
"In Huaxu's history, meteors were never symbols of luck or wish fulfilment. Instead, they called them 'Broom Stars', regarding them as omens of disaster and peril. Yet ironically, Huaxu became the earliest recorded nation to use meteorite products. It seems that when faced with practicality, the people of Huaxu were not opposed to overturning a few beliefs."

— Tacitus, Elysian Historian, in "Chronicles"

name: Golden Wool
desc: Wool of golden hue, reminiscent of mythical treasures. It's true that golden sheep are real, and for those with ample means, their wool can be woven into sweaters. Yet, this golden fleece is susceptible to static, making the wearer spark with movement.
desc2:
"O spindle of destiny,
With what does the merciless goddess weave thee?
Is it with the delicate threads of spiders from the abyss?
The golden fleece upon high peaks?
Or the subtle original sin coursing through our veins?!"

— Anonymous Poet, Excerpt from "The Spindle of the Goddess of Fate"

name: Bottled Lightning
desc: Lightning ensnared by the people of Huaxu, continuing its restless dance within the bottle. This craft traces back two centuries to the priest who braved the Thunder Plains alone, anointing himself as the hunter.
desc2:
"No child could spurn a vial of captured lightning — its sparks that dance at your fingertips, like your very own genie in a bottle. In war-torn times, for many a child who has lost their family and friends, solace is found solely in this tiny bottle."

— Dylan the Walking Encyclopedia, in "Into the Unseen Corners"

name: Lense of Enlightenment
desc: A monocle that comes with various exquisite chains, favoured by Aethyrie's scholarly elite, hence dubbed "Lense of Enlightenment".
desc2:
"Not anyone could pull off these glasses — you either need to have deep-set eyes or strong eye muscles, I mean REALLY strong! From what I've seen, professors of the latter type usually have a short fuse — always either scowling like they're trying to squash a fly between their eyebrows or glaring at you with a squint. Trust me, no good can come from taking their classes."

— An Aethyrie Senior Who Prefers Anonymity

name: Golden Floriated Diadem
desc: Bestowed by the Elysian Church, adorned only by those of esteemed reverence, its interlaced flowers and foliage represent devotion and allegiance, embodying a faith as pure as gold.
desc2:
"Ugh, this thing's so heavy! Can't even lift my head properly!"

— Lisbell, candidate for "Patience" of the Seven Virtues of Elysium

name: Copy of Elysian Hymnal
desc: An Elysian Church classic, penned in verse for singing. It embodies divine teachings chronicled by patriarchs over the years, an aged print from bygone days.
desc2:
"The first deity grants you life, to breathe and thrive on this land.
The second bestows a bounteous tide, enriching years ahead.
The third with wisdom's fire alight, to guide your soul through dark nights.
...
'Tis I who bring the final quest, to soothe your journey into rest."

— Extracted from the Elysian Scriptures, "Hymnal Vol. 1"

name: Scales of Eternal Justice
desc: Scales symbolizing equality and justice, essential in the Elysian Church rituals. Should divine favour shift, the scales would tilt. Fortunately, the grace of the Great Nine has remained unchanged.
desc2:
"Beneath the sun's gaze, no shadow may lie.
In balance's scales, no bias resides.
Thy pleas acknowledged, thy sins to be tried.
A blade of dual edges, justice and retribution abide."

— Oath of the Elysian Judicial Ceremony

name: Rust-Etched Dagger
desc: A dagger mottled with rust, its elegant engravings a testament to its owner's nobility; perhaps a personal possession of a soul fallen on ancient battlefields.
desc2:
"The Empire's coming for a fight? Well, they'll get one! Not all Charons are willing to be their poodles! Ha, I'll chop them down, grab their fancy weapons, and make a mountain out of their corpses — right where we always do!"

— An Askard Tribesperson

name: Obsidian Key
desc: In Aethyrie, obsidian symbolizes the inspiration of the night. Each Charon scholar from Aethyrie receives this key upon graduation. The significance known only to its bearer.
desc2:
"The realm of knowledge shows no favouritism, opening its doors equally to Solas and Charons. Just shed the heavy shackles and roam freely in pursuit of enlightenment. Bear in mind, even in the darkest of nights, our thoughts glow with undimmed light."

— Professor Montpelier, Arcadia Academy of Aethyrie

name: Tome of the Noclunism Ritual
desc: The Noclunism, renouncing the Great Nine to embrace the "Abyss", compiles its doctrines in a tome naturally deemed taboo. Yet, such forbidden knowledge beckons enticingly — for the curious, it unlocks gateways to a new world.
desc2:
"The full moon weeps despair,
The abyss cradles lunacy.
The gods' domain lies in the unilluminated side,
While feeble fakes mire in a futile dither."

— Tome of The Noclunism Ritual, Heresy of Elysium, "Beyond the Moon's Veil - Chapter Ⅱ"

name: Filthoid Cell Culture Dish
desc: A sealed vessel originating from the Hyperborean Empire, containing the cellular essence of Filthoids. Before opening, it's an absolute black box, potentially defying expectations but also capable of bringing unforeseen wonders or horrors.
desc2:
"Experiment Log No. ■■■, Code 740■■31■■■, now commencing. Coolant engaged, safety pin removed, pressure valve released. All personnel, recheck your protective gear — What in the world is that!!! Back off! NOW!! ■■ cells showing unidentifiable aberrations, taking on a radiant form■■■■, I can't ■■, request immediate■■■■■■■■■■■"

— Record of an experiment gone wrong

name: Twilight Tread
desc: Reflecting on the long path traveled, all the memories have been woven into a tapestry of stars. The joys and sorrows contained within them have become the evidence of growth.
desc2:
"Child, even though the path ahead is uncertain, always proceed with determination."

— Lady Nifle, Ferrywoman of the Misty Sea

name: Ring of Severed Fear
desc: Only by confronting what once terrified you can you truly take control of it.
desc2:
"One day, I realised I could no longer cry. Perhaps it was the battlefield smoke clouding my eyes — or perhaps I had, at last, parted ways with the weakness in me."

— From the notes of a Hyperborean soldier

name: Ring of Escaped Entropy
desc: Only by confronting what once terrified you can you truly take control of it.
desc2:
"Lamp on my helmet, pick in my grip — down the shaft we chase Phoxene's glint.
We sweat, we bleed, we strain our bones — so we'll get rich with these stones!"

— Miner's folk rhyme, Icelake

name: Ring of Chronal Reversion
desc: Only by confronting what once terrified you can you truly take control of it.
desc2:
"Time does not speak. It merely ushers each newborn dawn into the hush of night, and each bitter winter into the bloom of spring."

— Lady Nifle, Ferrywoman of the Misty Sea

name: Ring of Justice Rekindled
desc: Only by confronting what once terrified you can you truly take control of it.
desc2:
"Sure, we've all got our brand of justice. And justice always arrives late. So today, right here — let my blade call the shots. Sound good?"

— Kezhou, Swordsman of Huaxu

name: Iron Emblem
desc: A symbol of the Hyperborean Legion's great achievements and glory. Yet, individual success often correlates with collective sacrifice.
desc2:
"We require no medals, for loyalty itself is the finest commendation."

— A Veteran from The 1st Legion of Hyperborean Empire

desc: A symbol of the Hyperborean Legion's great achievements and glory. Yet, individual success often correlates with collective sacrifice.

name: Veil of Silence
desc: Only through silence and self-exploration can one achieve growth from the inside out.

name: Eye of Infinity
desc: Only through receptivity and self-exploration can one achieve growth from the inside out.

name: Crown of Enlightenment
desc: Only through introspection and self-exploration can one achieve growth from the inside out.

name: Herbal Sprig
desc: Medicine administration is an art that heavily depends on experience. It is through the lessons learned in growth that a healer can always determine the most suitable dosage at any given time.
desc2:
"Biru, with its verdant hue and astringent taste, offers a subtle aftertaste of sweetness a moment after consumption. Taken in proper amounts, it can calm the mind and soothe the spirit, as well as nourish wounds. However, improper dosage carries the risk of causing numbness."

— Fufeng, Huaxu Apothecary, in "Essentials of Medicinal Herbs"

name: Gleaming Arrow
desc: Experienced archers can hit the target even without aiming. The moment they lay their hands on strings and arrows, the memories engraved in their bodies spark.
desc2:
"True that we excel at archery, but making it the focus of a coming-of-age ceremony? It's purely biased."

— An Askard Tribesperson

desc: Experienced archers can hit the target even without aiming. The moment they lay their hands on strings and arrows, the memories engraved in their bodies spark.

name: Basic Weapon Component: Grip
desc: Crafted with precision from the blueprint of a basic weapon component. As the part closest to the wielder, the essence of its design is to ensure optimal "handiness."
desc2:
"He is advancing,
He is advancing!
I hear his thunderous steps resound,
I hear the Sword of Torrent scrape on the ground!
He shall claim the lives of the unjust,
No one here can escape the tempest!
None can resist death's looming tonight,
Nor wrest the sword from his grasp so tight!"

— Excerpt from Le Rhapsodie de Torrent, by Alexandre Thomas, a mourning faction playwright

name: Basic Weapon Component: Blade
desc: Crafted with precision from the blueprint of a basic weapon component. Whether the blade is curved or straight, light or heavy, its edge is honed exclusively for battle.
desc2:
"The essence of swordsmanship lies in the unity of the wielder's spirit. With utmost focus, one can cleave through the mightiest foes, be they ocean waves or leviathans."

— Excerpt from The Art of the Sword, by a nameless swordsman from Huaxu

desc: Crafted with precision from the blueprint of a basic weapon component. It embodies the wielder's will — only the strong are entitled to showcase their unique individuality on the battlefield.
desc2:
"What's so bad about being different? People are always bending over backwards trying to prove how unique they are. Me? Ha, I was born an outcast, a natural oddity shunned by Father Ask, the most bizarre ornament in the tribe!"

— "The Raven" Chaos, from The Forsakens

name: Basic Weapon Component: Barrel
desc: Crafted with precision from the blueprint of a basic weapon component. Bullets burst forth from here, as both the barrel and the warrior's heart blaze with unrelenting fervour.
desc2:
"I know everyone here likes to think of themselves as artists, but seriously, you're all a bunch of morons. What you do is simply alchemy, medicine, or drawing. What's the point of obsessing over the meaning of life or the consequences of your work? Check out this new gun I made — awesome, right?"

— Nisaya, Weapon Master of The Aeolipile

name: Basic Weapon Component: Bolt
desc: Crafted with precision from the blueprint of a basic weapon component. There is no turning back once the trigger is pulled, much like the commitment that seals a decisive moment.
desc2:
"The trigger is the most crucial part of any mechanical device. Even from a developer's perspective, I can tell you — no matter how intricate the internal workings are, it's just a piece of scrap if the trigger doesn't function properly. Trust me, I speak from experience — if my trigger had jammed back then, I wouldn't be here today."

— An unnamed veteran traveller

name: Basic Weapon Component: Frame
desc: Crafted with precision from the blueprint of a basic weapon component. Sturdy and robust, it doubles effectively as a blunt instrument or a throwable weapon when out of bullets.
desc2:
"Sure, the legion gives us some freedom to customise our weapons, but painting my gun pink? That's where I draw the line! I don't care if you're my sister, that's still a no. And take that teddy bear charm off!"

— Lynn, an officer of the Hyperborean Legion

desc2:
"Sturdy, with just the right amount of give. I daresay it'd make quite the stylish weapon in the hands of an assassin."

— An unnamed novelist in search of inspiration

name: Embla Inflorescence: Upper Limb
desc: Crafted with precision from the blueprint of Embla Inflorescence. The graceful curve not only withstands immense stress but also enhances the bow's resilience, ensuring efficient and precise energy transfer.
desc2:
"Supple, yet strong — just what you need for a proper bow."

— Lunosmith

name: Embla Inflorescence: Lower Limb
desc: Crafted with precision from the blueprint of Embla Inflorescence. The graceful curve not only withstands immense stress but also enhances the bow's resilience, ensuring efficient and precise energy transfer.
desc2:
"Supple, yet strong — just what you need for a proper bow."

— Lunosmith

name: Embla Inflorescence: Riser
desc: Crafted with precision from the blueprint of Embla Inflorescence. With an ideal blend of rigidity and flexibility, it balances precision and strength, steering each arrow with the accuracy of a seasoned navigator, calibrating its trajectory.
desc2:
"A bow that can't hit its mark is just a fancy stick! There's got to be a way to improve its accuracy."

— An unnamed bowyer

name: Siren's Kiss: Grip
desc: Crafted with precision from the blueprint of Siren's Kiss. As the component closest to the wielder, the essence of its design is to ensure optimal "handiness."
desc2:
"He is advancing,
He is advancing!
I hear his thunderous steps resound,
I hear the Sword of Torrent scrape on the ground!
He shall claim the lives of the unjust,
No one here can escape the tempest!
None can resist death's looming tonight,
Nor wrest the sword from his grasp so tight!"

— Excerpt from Le Rhapsodie de Torrent, by Alexandre Thomas, a mourning faction playwright

name: Siren's Kiss: Blade
desc: Crafted with precision from the blueprint of Siren's Kiss. Whether the blade is curved or straight, light or heavy, its edge is honed exclusively for battle.
desc2:
"The essence of swordsmanship lies in the unity of the wielder's spirit. With utmost focus, one can cleave through the mightiest foes, be they ocean waves or leviathans."

— Excerpt from The Art of the Sword, by a nameless swordsman from Huaxu

— Lynn, an officer of the Hyperborean Legion

name: Ruinstem: Barrel
desc: Crafted with precision from the blueprint of Ruinstem. Bullets burst forth from here, as both the barrel and the warrior's heart blaze with unrelenting fervour.
desc2:
"I know everyone here likes to think of themselves as artists, but seriously, you're all a bunch of morons. What you do is simply alchemy, medicine, or drawing. What's the point of obsessing over the meaning of life or the consequences of your work? Check out this new gun I made — awesome, right?"

— Nisaya, Weapon Master of The Aeolipile

name: Wailmaw: Bolt
desc: Crafted with precision from the blueprint of Wailmaw. There is no turning back once the trigger is pulled, much like the commitment that seals a decisive moment.
desc2:
"The trigger is the most crucial part of any mechanical device. Even from a developer's perspective, I can tell you — no matter how intricate the internal workings are, it's just a piece of scrap if the trigger doesn't function properly. Trust me, I speak from experience — if my trigger had jammed back then, I wouldn't be here today."

— An unnamed veteran traveller

name: Wailmaw: Frame
desc: Crafted with precision from the blueprint of Wailmaw. Sturdy and robust, it doubles effectively as a blunt instrument or a throwable weapon when out of bullets.

name: Dove of Tomorrow: Grip
desc: Crafted with precision from the blueprint of Dove of Tomorrow. As the component closest to the wielder, the essence of its design is to ensure optimal handling.
desc2:
"He is advancing,
He is advancing!
I hear his thunderous steps resound,
I hear the Sword of Torrent scrape on the ground!
He shall claim the lives of the unjust,
No one here can escape the tempest!
None can resist death's looming tonight,
Nor wrest the sword from his grasp so tight!"

— Excerpt from Le Rhapsodie de Torrent, by Alexandre Thomas, a mourning faction playwright

name: Dove of Tomorrow: Blade
desc: Crafted with precision from the blueprint of Dove of Tomorrow. Whether the blade is curved or straight, light or heavy, its edge is honed exclusively for battle.
desc2:
"The essence of swordsmanship lies in the unity of the wielder's spirit. With utmost focus, one can cleave through the mightiest foes, be they ocean waves or leviathans."

— Excerpt from The Art of the Sword, by a nameless swordsman from Huaxu

name: Soulprint: Tapestry
desc: Where countless threads of the heart entwine, a Soulprint takes form — Tapestry.
desc2: To guard memory from time's reach, we tuck it gently into cherished items. And when these resurface, the Soulprints sealed within stir... and bloom before our eyes.
